subject: Request: CloudSigma Azure private listing — custom rev-share & Net90 approval
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: CloudSigma Azure private listing — custom rev-share & Net90 approval

Team,

CloudSigma wants to list our Azure private offer this quarter but is asking for two non-standard items we need exec sign-off on: an 18% rev-share (vs our standard 15%) and Net90 payment terms. They are a strategic mid-market account (expected first-year ARR $440k) and have committed to a 12-month consumption minimum of $300k.

Key facts:
- Partner: CloudSigma (SaaS infra)
- SKU: azure-std-large, estimated token usage ~2.1B tokens/yr
- Revenue signal: $440k ARR expected Yr1 with step-up commitment
- Ask: Rev-share 18% (one-off for this listing), payment Net90, SAML SSO onboarding support window (2 weeks accelerated)

Risk/impact:
- Rev-share +3pts equates to ~$13k incremental payout over Yr1 vs standard; higher long-term marginal cost if adoption scales.
- Net90 increases DSO and cash risk to finance.
- SSO onboarding acceleration adds 0.5 FTE engineering support for 4 weeks (we can offset with professional services fee).

Proposed mitigations (recommended):
1) Approve 18% rev-share for 12 months only, revert to standard 15% thereafter.
2) Grant Net60 instead of Net90, with Net90 allowed only if they sign a 24-month commitment addendum.
3) Charge a $12,500 deployment/SSO concierge fee to cover 2 weeks of eng + priority rollout.
4) Require HubSpot deal record HS-76543 to include monthly usage checkpoints and a $50k onboarding credit recoupable over 6 months if adoption lags.

Attachments: CloudSigma_PrivateOffer_Azure_20281109.pdf (proposal) and CloudSigma_MA-projections_20281109.xlsx (financials).

Can we get an approval or alternate direction by EOD PST today? CloudSigma needs a signed private listing by COB Monday to make their marketplace submission window.

Thanks,
Hannah
---
Hannah Schmitt
Account Exec, Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Nov 2028 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: CloudSigma Azure private listing — custom rev-share & Net90 approval

Hannah — thanks for the write-up, concise and helpful. A few clarifying points before I escalate to Revenue Ops / Legal for a one-off: 

1) The 12-month 18% cap is sensible, but we should tie it to a usage gate (e.g., must hit $250k consumption in first 90 days) to avoid open-ended exposure.
2) Net90 is a stretch; finance will push back. If Finance allows Net90 only with a 24-month commitment and a shorter initial Net60 trial caught up by contractual lock, that's acceptable.
3) For SSO concierge fee: prefer PS invoice milestone-based (50% up-front, balance on completion). This helps cashflow.

Ask to Hannah: can you confirm CloudSigma is willing to sign AH (amendment + 24-month commitment) and accept the PS milestone schedule? If yes I will route to Legal + RevOps and request an expedited approval path (senior sign-off) — I estimate 24–36 hours for review if they accept the amendment.

I will flag this as a special market-facing exception and document the rev-share as an addendum that expires automatically 12 months from listing.

-Karthik
---
Karthik Iyer
Head of Deal Desk
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Nov 2028 12:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: CloudSigma Azure private listing — custom rev-share & Net90 approval

Quick finance POV:
- Net90: not preferred. Cash pressure acceptable only if there is either (a) a committed prepayment or (b) a 24-month contractual lock with penalties for early termination. We prefer Net60 with a 30% upfront credit against first invoice if they insist on extended terms.
- Rev-share: incremental 3ppt is fine with a hard sunset (12 months) and clear clawback if they fail usage milestones.
- Onboarding credit: make it an accounting-deferrable customer-funded credit (i.e., recoup on usage) rather than a marketing write-off.

If sales accepts Net60+30% upfront and the legal amendment for 24 months, Finance can sign off immediately.

Aditya
VP, Finance Operations
aditya.rao@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Nov 2028 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: APPROVED: CloudSigma Azure private listing — conditional approval

Approved with conditions below. Hannah, please confirm CloudSigma agrees to these items in writing before we route to Legal for signature: 

1) Rev-share set to 18% for exactly 12 months from listing activation. Automatic revert to 15% after 12 months.
2) Net60 standard with 30% upfront payment due at signing. If CloudSigma insists on Net90, they must sign a 24-month minimum commitment addendum (legal to add early termination penalties and clawback).
3) SSO concierge: bill as Professional Services at $12,500 with 50% upfront. PS must be invoiced and collected outside the rev-share reconciliation.
4) Usage gate: minimum $250k consumption in first 90 days or rev-share re-evaluated and potential clawback of onboarding credit.

Karthik/Legal: please prepare the amendment and rev-share addendum (HS-76543) and route for DocuSign as soon as we get CloudSigma confirmation. Hannah: get written confirmation today if possible — CloudSigma indicated they are on a tight marketplace submission window.

Marissa
SVP, Revenue
